title: Order Tracking
description: Learn how to track orders, add tracking numbers, and provide customers with order tracking information.
content:
Order Tracking

Order tracking allows you and your customers to monitor order status and shipping progress throughout the fulfillment process.

Adding Tracking Numbers

Step 1: Access Order

Navigate to the order you want to track and open its details page.

Step 2: Add Tracking Information

In the shipping section, add:

  • Tracking number
  • Shipping carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, USPS)
  • Tracking URL (if available)

Step 3: Save and Notify

Save the tracking information. The customer will receive an email notification with tracking details.

Supported Carriers

Track orders from various shipping carriers:

  • FedEx
  • UPS
  • USPS
  • DHL
  • Canada Post
  • Royal Mail
  • Custom carriers
  • Local shipping companies

Customer Tracking

Customers can track their orders:

  • Order confirmation email includes tracking link
  • Shipping notification email with tracking details
  • My Orders page in customer account
  • Direct tracking link

Tracking Status

Orders show tracking status:

  • Order Placed
  • Processing
  • Shipped
  • In Transit
  • Out for Delivery
  • Delivered

Bulk Tracking Updates

Update tracking for multiple orders:

  • Select multiple orders
  • Bulk add tracking numbers
  • Bulk send tracking notifications

Tracking Integrations

Integrate with shipping services:

  • Automatic tracking number import
  • Real-time tracking updates
  • Carrier API integration
  • Label printing with tracking

Custom Tracking

For custom shipping solutions:

  • Manual tracking number entry
  • Custom tracking URL format
  • Internal tracking system

Tracking Notifications

Customers receive notifications:

  • Email when tracking is added
  • Email when status changes
  • SMS notifications (if enabled)
  • In-app notifications

Best Practices

  • Add tracking as soon as order ships
  • Use clear, accurate tracking numbers
  • Notify customers promptly
  • Provide tracking links when possible
  • Monitor tracking status regularly
  • Handle delivery issues promptly
